'''Rennax Omani''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Rennax Omani was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] in the years leading up to the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], Omani reluctantly took on the role of [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] as she was taken as the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[B'ink Utrila]]. During her early apprenticeship, Omani accompanied her Master to recover a [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith amulet]] - the [[Gauntlet of Kressh the Younger]] - from a [[Jedi Temple (Draay 2)|temple]] on [[Draay 2]] in order to prevent [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] from obtaining it with the aid of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. While in the temple, Omani frustrated her master by her apparent inability to recall simple lessons from her time at the [[Jedi academy|Temple academy]]. Following the destruction of the temple and their completion of the mission, Omani decided to leave the Order and return to her homeworld and seek out her parents. Utrila supported the girl's decision and allowed her to leave the Order in her good graces.<ref name="Defenders of TLT" />
